documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Board Meeting Outcome for Change In Designation Of Mr. Rohan Mittal As The "Chief Commercial & Development Officer - MEA"
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Transcript Of The 31St Annual General Meeting Of The Company

analysis.summary: VA Tech Wabag reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue of INR 887 crores, representing a 20.8% year-over-year growth, and EBITDA of INR 116 crores, up 21.7% year-over-year. The company maintained a net cash positive position for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance of INR 965 crores and reached a historic high order book of INR 19,400 crores. Management highlighted robust order intake, ongoing execution of major municipal and industrial projects globally, and continuous focus on advanced technology, payment security, and disciplined capital allocation. VA Tech Wabag reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY2027, driven by robust order inflows across domestic and international clusters that pushed its order book to approximately INR 19,400 crores. The company maintained a positive net cash position for the 14th consecutive quarter, reaching INR 9,65 crores, and extended its profitable growth trajectory with improved margins and execution discipline.

guidance.claim: Management targets a blended EBITDA margin outlook staying within 13% to 15%.
guidance.quote: And that is why in our medium-term outlook, we gave a blended EBITDA margin outlook of staying within 13% to 15% of EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management stated a medium-term outlook targeting a revenue CAGR of 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: 15% to 20% CAGR of revenue, this year we did almost 20% on the higher side of the band.

guidance.claim: Management guided an EBITDA margin band of 13% to 15%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA 13% to 15%, we've firmly remained in that band not just this year, but over the last 2 to 3 years.

guidance.claim: Management's medium-term outlook is to take the O&M share up to 20%.
guidance.quote: O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20% and we are working and on track from that perspective.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing water security needs driven by urbanization, climate change, industrialization, and tightening environmental standards continue to support demand for desalination and reuse.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we see a healthy opportunity pipeline across our target markets, growing water security needs driven by urbanization, climate change, industrialization and tightening environmental standards continue to support demand for desalination and reuse, particularly in water stressed regions.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite recent geopolitical developments, management has seen no material impact on projects, operations, or underlying demand in the GCC.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the recent geopolitical developments, we have seen no material impact on our projects, operations or underlying demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the order pipeline indicates significant growth opportunities going forward.
demand_outlook.quote: Our order pipeline indicates significant growth opportunities even going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: All clusters delivered on order intake resulting in the order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: All clusters delivered on order intake which resulted in our order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores, even as we persisted with our selective approach to bidding for projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the capital allocated for water is at an all-time high across their geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: See the capital which is allocated for water is all-time high.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted emerging market opportunities of $75 billion to $100 billion in the next five to seven years across their core regions.
demand_outlook.quote: And if you put all this together, this is almost 75 billion to 100 billion in next five to seven years is the opportunity.

demand_outlook.claim: Management identified future energy and technology sectors as a further market opportunity of $5 billion to $6 billion.
demand_outlook.quote: And the future energy sector, which I told you solar, semiconductor, data centers and all, this is further 5 billion to 6 billion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at over 13% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR 116 crores, growing by 21.7% year-over-year with an EBITDA margin of over 13%.

margins_costs.claim: Return on Capital Employed was 19.6% and Return on Equity was 16% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We continue to focus on effective cash and debt management across the Group, along with delivering healthy returns on capital, with Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) at 19.6% and Return on Equity (ROE) at 16% for this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Margins continued to remain in line with the company's medium term target.
margins_costs.quote: Our strong performance is reflected in excellent execution discipline, with margins continuing to remain in line with our medium term target.

margins_costs.claim: Management emphasized their commitment to profitable growth where bottom-line growth outpaces top-line growth.
margins_costs.quote: If we grow on top line 20%, we ensure that the bottom line grows more than 20%. That's what is profitable growth.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted that O&M is a high-margin and margin-accretive business segment.
margins_costs.quote: This is recurring annuity, cash-accretive, margin-accretive, asset-light, very, very low on risk.

orders_capacity.claim: Order intake during Q1 was over INR 3,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order intake during Q1 was over INR 34 billion, over INR 3,400 crores, of which about INR 29.6 billion was EPC and INR 4.7 billion was O&M.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book position reached a historic high of INR 19,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book position reached a historic high of INR 194 billion, that is INR 19,400 crores, almost $1.8 billion, which is over four times of our revenue base, providing very strong visibility for execution over the coming quarters and years.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book surged to approximately INR 19,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: All clusters delivered on order intake which resulted in our order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores, even as we persisted with our selective approach to bidding for projects.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported a closing order backlog of INR 17,200 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Today we have INR17,200 crore of order backlog.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that their order intake for the year was nearly INR 7,500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order intake we closed with INR 7,500 crore almost that is year-over-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that O&M accounts for approximately 40% of their order backlog.
orders_capacity.quote: O&M is almost 40% of our order backlog.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remained net cash positive for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance of INR 965 crores excluding HAM.
capital_allocation.quote: We continued our net cash positive position for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance, excluding HAM standing at INR 965 crores as of this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The company extended its positive net cash position streak to the 14th consecutive quarter to reach INR 965 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In this quarter, we continued to grow profitably, extending our positive net cash position streak to the 14th consecutive quarter to reach INR 965 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated the company closed the year as net cash positive for the sixth consecutive year.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year as net cash positive for sixth consecutive year and thirteenth consecutive quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per share, up from INR 4 last year.
capital_allocation.quote: And in line with the performance, the board recommended a final dividend of INR 5/- per share, up from INR 4/- last year, recommended to the shareholders for approval.

capital_allocation.claim: Management reported net cash excluding HAM investments stands at INR 950 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash, excluding the investment in HAM, is INR 950 crore, because our borrowing is less or more or less close to INR 100 crores because that's the working capital we take because we don't want to break our fixed deposits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that government spending shifts toward oil could lead to reduced spending in other areas.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government spending, it depends like now, if we are spending more money on the oil, naturally government will have to cut down some spending somewhere.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited currency and raw material volatility as effects of geopolitical situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Currency and raw material volatility, this is also something which is an effect of geopolitical situations.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to take the industrial order mix to around 20% to 25% over a period of time.
management_commitments.quote: So, we would say over a period of time, our objective will remain to take industrial order mix to be around 20% to 25%.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a 20% reduction of emissions under direct control (scope 1 and scope 2) by 2035.
management_commitments.quote: Achieve a 20% reduction of emissions under direct control (scope 1 & scope 2) by 2035

management_commitments.claim: The organization targets an increase in water positivity by 50% by 2030.
Management is committed to increasing gender diversity among employees through a 12% female employee mix by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Increase gender diversity among employees through 12% female employee mix by 2030

management_commitments.claim: Management stated their medium-term target to keep the order book at least 3x of revenues.
management_commitments.quote: We said we will keep our order book at least 3x of revenues.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted a revenue CAGR of 15% to 20% over the medium term.
management_commitments.quote: 15% to 20% CAGR of revenue, this year we did almost 20% on the higher side of the band.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated their medium-term goal to maintain EBITDA margins between 13% and 15%.
management_commitments.quote: EBITDA 13% to 15%, we've firmly remained in that band not just this year, but over the last 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted a 3 to 5-year outlook to take O&M contribution to 20%.
management_commitments.quote: O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20% and we are working and on track from that perspective.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
